_seeds_note: Your OWN inboxes, so you can see where your mail actually lands (Inbox vs Spam). Injected at seed_positions within each account's queue. NOTE: a position larger than that account's batch never fires - if each account only sends 40, use something like [1, 20, 40], not [1, 120, 240]. Seeds are not counted as real sends and are never written to sent_log.csv.
_caps_note: Gmail free tier hard-limits ~500 recipients/day per account. 370 leaves headroom for your normal personal mail. NEVER raise this to 500.
